title: MED+250 anonymous-auth rate-limit approval
summary: Owner-ready approval for the project-wide anonymous-auth limit after intended-use, abuse-control and shared-application impact testing. The selected limit, monitoring conditions, rollback criteria and security-owner signature remain pending.

checks.name: Controlled rate-limit test complete
checks.detail: The paired intended-use and abuse-limit test remains pending and therefore cannot yet support accountable approval of the project-wide setting.

checks.name: Shared-project impact accepted
checks.detail: The security owner must record that the selected limit is acceptable for MED+250 and every other application using the same Supabase Auth project.

checks.name: Legitimate demand and abuse risk balanced
checks.detail: The approval must document the expected peak customer-session profile, abuse threat, selected threshold, time window and evidence supporting the decision.

checks.name: Monitoring and rollback conditions approved
checks.detail: Named alert thresholds, change authority, incident response, rollback criteria and next review date have not yet been approved.

checks.name: Turnstile dependency accepted
checks.detail: The security owner must confirm the approved limit assumes production server-side Turnstile remains enabled and that weakening CAPTCHA is not an allowed capacity response.

checks.name: Named security-owner signature
checks.detail: The accountable security owner has not yet recorded the final decision, conditions, named approver, role and timezone-qualified approval timestamp.

completion_instructions: Complete and strictly validate the paired controlled test.
Review the shared-project impact, legitimate peak profile, abuse risk, selected threshold, time window, monitoring, rollback and change-authority decisions.
Record the selected limit, time window and timezone-qualified next review date without including identities or provider secrets.
Confirm the review digest still matches, set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed approval strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
